ValidationRule.description: Address, City, State, Postal Code, Country, Type, Status, Rent and Description are mandatory.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( ISBLANK(Address__c), ISBLANK(City__c), ISBLANK(State__c), ISBLANK(Postal_Code__c), ISBLANK(Country__c), ISPICKVAL(Type__c, ''), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, ''), ISBLANK(Price__c), ISBLANK(Description__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Address, City, State, Postal Code, Country, Type, Status, Rent and Description are required.
